Combined operations

Macros to clarify source code that combine several operations in one macro.  For instance, macros to copy HL to DE or IX to DE, that require 2 or more instructions but are commonly used.

Macros
ld__hl_de

Copy DE to HL, using 2 instructions COST: 2 us (8 CPU Cycles)

ld__de_hl

Copy HL to DE, using 2 instructions (ld d, h : ld e, l) COST: 2 us (8 CPU Cycles)

ld__de_ix

Copy IX to DE, using 2 instructions (ld e, ixl : ld d, ixh) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__bc_ix

Copy IX to BC, using 2 instructions (ld c, ixl : ld b, ixh) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__hl_ix

Copy IX to HL, using 4 instructions.  Modifies A Register COST: 6 us (24 CPU Cycles)

ld__ix_de

Copy DE to IX, using 2 instructions (ld ixl, e : ld ixh, d) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__ix_bc

Copy BX to IX, using 2 instructions (ld ixl, c : ld ixh, b) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__ix_hl

Copy HL to IX, using 4 instructions.  Modifies A Register COST: 6 us (24 CPU Cycles)

ld__de_iy

Copy IY to DE, using 2 instructions (ld e, iyl : ld d, iyh) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__bc_iy

Copy IY to BC, using 2 instructions (ld c, iyl : ld b, iyh) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__hl_iy

Copy IY to HL, using 4 instructions.  Modifies A Register COST: 6 us (24 CPU Cycles)

ld__iy_de

Copy DE to IY, using 2 instructions (ld iyl, e : ld iyh, d) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__iy_bc

Copy BX to IY, using 2 instructions (ld iyl, c : ld iyh, b) COST: 4 us (16 CPU Cycles)

ld__iy_hl

Copy HL to IY, using 4 instructions.  Modifies A Register COST: 6 us (24 CPU Cycles)

ld__ix_iy

Copy IY to IX, using 4 instructions.  Modifies A Register Cost: 8 us (32 CPU Cycles)

ld__iy_ix

Copy IX to IY, using 4 instructions.  Modifies A Register Cost: 8 us (32 CPU Cycles)

ex__de_ix

Swap DE with IX Modifies A Register Cost: 10 us (40 CPU Cycles)

ex__bc_ix

Swap BC with IX Modifies A Register Cost: 10 us (40 CPU Cycles)

ex__hl_ix

Swap HL with IX Uses 2 bytes on the stack for the swap Modifies A register Cost: 15 us (60 CPU Cycles)

ex__de_iy

Swap DE with IY Modifies A Register Cost: 10 us (40 CPU Cycles)

ex__bc_iy

Swap BC with IY Modifies A Register Cost: 10 us (40 CPU Cycles)

ex__hl_iy

Swap HL with IY Uses 2 bytes on the stack for the swap Modifies A register Cost: 15 us (60 CPU Cycles)
